name: Hypno Town
source:
You're playing as Hilbert, who had completed his pokemon journey and is now on the way to Nuvema Town to meet his family and start a science career as a pokemon researcher. However, sudden car crash destroyed all your plans. Thus your Pokemon, Hypno, has mysteriously disappeared after the accident. Who knows what he might do now that he's free?

Furthermore, Hilbert should discover what changes are happening with Nuvema Town after it becomes the first town in the World with a human-pokemon free relationship zone.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/hypnotown]Patreon[/url]]
